summary: Give dependent steps awaiting first readiness the same scheduling priority as initial work

replay.detail: This changes evaluation order over existing current-generation step state. No claim replay.

schema.detail: The priority existence check uses the existing generation index and readiness_epoch column. No table or index changes.

rules.detail: Current pending or blocked steps with readiness 0 put their run in the first-readiness priority group, including partially progressed runs. Existing readiness predicates decide promotion.

compatibility.detail: Satisfied dependent steps can receive readiness before newer gate writers that have already offered readiness. Each finite snapshot retains every active run, with newest-first order inside each priority group.

manual.detail: The normal reactive scheduler applies the order automatically.

recovery.detail: Readiness epoch and claim fencing retain their existing transitions.
